sources.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 2D game animation atlas, EIGHT full-body key drawings in FOUR equal COLUMNS and TWO equal ROWS, landscape 2048x1024. Input image 1 is the existing orange fire hatchling character and eight actions to refine, NOT the pixel-art rendering style. Redraw it in polished hand-painted anime RPG animation style, smooth crisp contours (NO pixels), warm sculpted cel shading with controlled soft transitions, bright expressive amber eyes, detailed ivory belly plates, subtly faceted golden horns, ruby-orange scales and luminous amber flame on tail. Preserve EXACT cute infant proportions, orange biped anatomy with two arms and two legs, two horns, small central flame crest, back spikes, one tail; NO wings, no armor, no extra accessories. The result must look like a sophisticated high-budget painted sprite, not a plastic 3D toy. Consistent light from upper left, restrained cool bounce along shadow-side edges; no glow outside silhouette except the tail flame. All eight face LEFT at same three-quarter angle, same head/body size, same camera, same ground baseline. Maintain same design across all poses, articulate limbs and bend tail naturally. Row-major pose order: 0 alert relaxed idle; 1 subtle chest inhale, eyelids half lowered, tip of tail curls inward slightly, feet unmoved; 2 crouched anticipation with rear foot planted and arms gathering; 3 powerful forward left claw/bite strike, rear foot planted; 4 low follow-through easing claws back; 5 standing recovery close to idle; 6 modest recoil RIGHT with eyes closed and nose still LEFT, both feet visible; 7 compact protective low brace. Do not create independent unrelated poses or change anatomy. Keep each entire figure, every horn, toe and flame inside its own cell with generous 35px empty gutter. No scenery, floor, shadows, projectiles, labels, dividers or text. Background must be genuinely transparent RGBA. If alpha is unavailable use perfectly flat saturated #ff00ff magenta ONLY; no checkerboard, no white or gray. Keep magenta entirely out of the character.

sources.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 2D RPG animation sprite atlas. Image 1 is the exact small purple hooded ghost character and eight actions. Refine this into premium hand-painted anime game art: richly shaded flowing indigo-violet cloth, fine clean folds with satin-like cool rim accents, beautiful expressive ruby-red translucent eyes with tiny crisp highlights, rounded pale-lilac face with soft cheek blush, small violet flame companion attached near cloak tail. Preserve original silhouette and cute personality, same hood, face, two hands, tapering torn cloak, NO feet, NO new accessories or embroidery, NO skulls. Smooth anti-aliased linework, no pixel texture, no plastic 3D, strong readable shapes at phone size. Eight drawings of the SAME model, same scale and light direction, all face LEFT three-quarter; gaze never reverses even in recoil. EIGHT poses in strict FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS landscape 2048x1024 with equal cells and generous transparent gutters. Row-major: 0 floating relaxed hands held ahead; 1 very subtle inhale with softer half-closed eyelids and curling lower cloak, face and hood position almost unchanged from 0; 2 lowered compressed anticipation with hands gathered; 3 forward spell thrust to LEFT, hands extended and cloak trails RIGHT; 4 lower follow-through with elbows bending back; 5 relaxed settling close to idle, cloak tips still moving; 6 modest backward recoil RIGHT eyes squeezed shut with nose to LEFT, hands startled, cloak counter-swings; 7 low defensive curl with both hands up. Articulate hands, cloth and expressions rather than using eight copies. Keep face/hood model CONSISTENT in every pose, same scale, hover bottom baseline. Contain every hood point, finger, cloth tip and flame within each cell, no overlap. No detached particles, scenery, floor shadows, glyphs, projectiles, borders, labels or text. Background genuinely transparent RGBA; if alpha impossible use perfectly flat saturated MAGENTA #ff00ff, NOT black/white/checkerboard. Avoid magenta inside the creature.
